This dataset contains more than 40,000 records of high-resolution NH₃ biosphere-atmosphere flux measurements compiled from 15 non-agricultural sites across ecosystems and pollution regimes (1991-2024). Measurements were obtained using micrometeorological techniques, primarily the aerodynamic gradient method (AGM) but also relaxed eddy accumulation (REA), and the state-of-the-art eddy covariance method (EC).
